text: Entry Requirements This program is open to all international students with a need to learn Chinese. Whether you are a beginner or have some foundation in Chinese, you are welcome to join. Applicants should have an interest in Chinese culture, voluntarily abide by Chinese laws and regulations, and have no record of violations or crimes. Applicants must be in good health. Applicants must be at least 16 years old at the time of enrollment and hold a valid foreign ordinary passport.
